fact: On 30 June the SCDM Steering Committee approved the digital certificate and revocation list of the State root certification authority run by the INTIC; CEDSIF, INAGE, Movitel and Business Connexion were preparing as second-level certification entities.
title: Comité Gestor do Sistema de Certificação Digital de Moçambique aprova os artefactos que vão dinamizar a Prestação de Serviços de Assinaturas Electrónicas em Moçambique
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Tecnologias de Informação e Comunicação
